title: Deer Valley Ultimate Mansion | KEY.co
description_expanded: Experience the epitome of luxury at this exquisite Deer Valley mansion, a true ski-in/ski-out retreat just steps from the Silver Dollar Ski Run. Spanning 6,700 square feet, this elegantly appointed home features six bedrooms and six-and-a-half bathrooms, accommodating up to 16 guests in sumptuous comfort. The home's interior exudes mountain contemporary elegance, with vaulted ceilings, a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, and expansive decks offering breathtaking views of Deer Valley. The spacious great room seamlessly integrates the living, dining, and kitchen areas, providing the perfect space for relaxation and entertaining. The gourmet kitchen, equipped with Viking and Wolf appliances, granite countertops, and a bar seating area, is a culinary haven for aspiring chefs. Each bedroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style, from the master suite with its king bed, stone fireplace, and spa-like bathroom, to the cozy bunk rooms perfect for families. The master bathroom features a jetted tub and a walk-in stone steam shower, offering a personal retreat after a day on the slopes. Located in a private, serene neighborhood, this home ensures a peaceful stay with strict adherence to noise and parking ordinances. Guests are just minutes from Park City's finest dining and shopping, making this mansion an ideal choice for those seeking an exclusive and tranquil getaway in Deer Valley. Whether you're hitting the slopes or enjoying the refined indoor amenities, this home offers an unparalleled vacation experience.
